intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A clerk on the path is writing very fast. Nerelle is watching his pen with alarm.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “I asked whether the lanterns were safe. He has written it down as a decree.”

intro.speaker: CLERK
intro.text: “‘The lanterns shall be safe.’ By order of Her Highness.”

options.labelText: “She was asking a question. Nerelle, what did you actually want to know?”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Thank you. Whether the third lantern is leaking. It is leaning to the left.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The clerk crosses out both decrees. After some thought, he underlines the crossing-out.

options.labelText: “Honestly? ‘The lanterns shall be safe’ is a pretty good law.”

branch.speaker: CLERK
branch.text: “‘A pretty good law.’ Endorsed by Her Highness’s companion. Noted.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Well. Now we are both in the law.”
